model_spec.assumption_note: Illustrative RAG-only scenario, not verified GPT-6-luna pricing/cache/context specifications. Zero cache minimum deliberately exercises cache behavior on this small fixture; UTF-8 byte estimates, no Codex overhead.

interpretation: Native Headroom lossless library compression with shared byte-based token estimates and modeled cache costs. Frozen answers, zero recovery-call overhead, no provider calls or answer-quality measurement. Native tokenizer counts and local compression time are separate diagnostics. Neither arm reproduces Headroom's default proxy/CCR/ML or opt-in net-cost gate. Cold refresh is this adapter's TTL-based reset of the frozen prefix, not Headroom's cold hook. Missing text or incomplete arms suppress savings. This evaluation does not fit a policy.

summary.historical_coverage_basis: Fraction of labeled historical requirements with one complete sufficient evidence alternative retained before recovery; AND within each alternative, OR across alternatives. Unknown requirements and direct lookup requirements are excluded, with unknown runs reported separately.
summary.interpretation: Modeled RAG-only cost in base-input-token equivalents. Byte-based token estimates; no Codex overhead or provider bill calibration. Recovery uses frozen task-label alternatives as an evaluation oracle, never runtime knowledge. No answer-quality replay or causal test. Unavailable bodies are unpriced; totals cover visible projection text only, not the hidden full workload. Recovery overhead is assumed zero: no expansion calls or restored content are inserted. Known missing requirements are still reported; frozen answers are not quality evidence.

summary.dependency_coverage_basis: Source availability from Headroom-verified lossless transformation; not independent semantic validation.
